verdict.rationale: Superpowers has event-driven behavior: skills auto-trigger, a SessionStart hook injects context, architectural review fires after three failed fixes, a circuit breaker trips after five review rounds, and a worktree is created automatically after brainstorming. Users can also author their own skills via writing-skills. However, these 'rules' are natural-language skills the model chooses to invoke rather than a deterministic event→action rules engine, and the event-driven behaviors are built in rather than user-defined. Missing for 10: a user-configurable event/trigger system with explicit event types and guaranteed (non-LLM-judged) firing, documentation of defining custom event-bound actions, independent corroboration that custom triggers fire reliably.
